d: Iran's Security Chief Mohsen Rezaei has threatened to bomb Europe if European nations allow US President Donald Trump to use their airbases to resume strikes on Iran. During the US-Iran war, American bombers, refuelers and fighter jets took off from some NATO bases in Europe to strike Iran. Now, the IRGC is threatening Europe to reconsider its support to Trump's war. Currently, Iran has the Khorramshahr-4 and the Sejjil ballistic missiles that can reach Europe.
